You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Which categories of machinery always require a conformity assessment procedure involving a notified body?

Facts:
[0] machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part A — requiresProcedure — specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2) (specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(2)) [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[1] machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3) (specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(3)) [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[2] machinery or related product substantially modified — requiresProcedure — conformity assessment procedure as provided in Article 25 (2), (3) and (4) (conformity assessment procedure as provided in article 25 (2), (3) and (4)) [REG, Art. 18]
[3] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) (conformity based on full quality assurance (module h)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[4] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — EU type-examination (module B) (eu type-examination (module b)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[5] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) (conformity based on unit verification (module g)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[6] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) (conformity to type based on internal production control (module c)) [condition: followed by EU type-examination (module B), under option (a)] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[7] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) (conformity based on full quality assurance (module h)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[8] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) (conformity to type based on internal production control (module c)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[9] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — EU type-examination (module B) (eu type-examination (module b)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[10] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) (conformity based on unit verification (module g)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[11] categories of machinery in Annex I Part B — requiresProcedure — one of the procedures referred to in Article 25(3) (one of the procedures referred to in article 25(3)) [REG, Annex I, Part B]
[12] machinery category not designed per harmonised standards — requiresProcedure — shall apply one of the procedures referred to in points (b), (c) or (d) (shall apply one of the procedures referred to in points (b), (c) or (d)) [condition: the machinery or related product was not designed and constructed in accordance with the harmonised standards] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[13] categories of machinery or related products — requiresProcedure — procedure referred to in Article 25(2) (procedure referred to in article 25(2)) [REG, Annex I, Part A]
[14] categories of machinery listed in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — one of the procedures referred to in Article 12(3) and (4) (one of the procedures referred to in article 12(3) and (4)) [DIR, Annex IV]
[15] category of machinery or related product — listedIn — Annex I, Part A (annex i, part a) [condition: if, according to the assessment referred to in paragraph 4, and taking into account the available information, it presents a serious inherent potential risk, and one or more of the following conditions is fulfilled] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[16] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall apply the procedure (shall apply the procedure for assessment of conformity) [condition: Where the machinery is not referred to in Annex IV] [DIR, Art. 12(2)]
[17] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — the EC type-examination procedure provided for in Annex IX (the ec type-examination procedure provided for in annex ix) [condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2)] [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[18] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — internal production control (module A) (internal production control (module a)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[19] category of machinery or related product not fulfilling points (a) to (d) — listedIn — Annex I, Part B (annex i, part b) [condition: does not fulfil one or more of the conditions in points (a) to (d)] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[20] manufacturers — hasObligation — carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25 or have it carried out (carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in article 25 or have it carried out) [condition: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[21] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — EC type-examination procedure (ec type-examination procedure) [condition: provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[22] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — the full quality assurance procedure provided for in Annex X (the full quality assurance procedure provided for in annex x) [condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2)] [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[23] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity (EU declaration of conformity) [condition: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[24] category of machinery or related product not listed in Annex I — requiresProcedure — internal production control procedure (module A) (internal production control procedure (module A)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is not listed in Annex I] [REG, Art. 25(4)]
[25] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — full quality assurance (full quality assurance) [DIR, Annex X]
[26] importers — hasObligation — shall ensure that the appropriate conformity assessment procedures (shall ensure that the appropriate conformity assessment procedures) [condition: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market] [REG, Art. 13(2)]
[27] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A (EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A) [condition: or alternatively, internet address or machine-readable code where that EU declaration of conformity can be accessed in the instructions for use] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[28] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall apply one of the following procedures (shall apply one of the following procedures) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[29] manufacturer, including a natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 — hasObligation — shall apply the internal production control procedure (shall apply the internal production control procedure) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is not listed in Annex I] [REG, Art. 25(4)]

response.text: {"kind": "set", "value": ["Categories of machinery listed in Annex I, Part A"], "text": "Machinery categories listed in Annex I, Part A must follow one of the Article 25(2) procedures: EU type-examination (module B) with conformity to type (module C), full quality assurance (module H), or unit verification (module G). Each of these involves a notified body. Categories in Annex I, Part B are not included because Article 25(3) also allows internal production control (module A), which involves no notified body.", "used": [0, 6, 7, 9, 10, 13, 18, 28]}
